title: Tartiflette
steps: Peel and slice potatoes into 5mm rounds. Boil in salted water for 10 min until just tender, then drain.
Preheat oven to 190°C. Rub a gratin dish with the cut garlic clove, then butter it.
Fry lardons in a dry pan until golden. Add sliced onions and cook 8 min until soft. Pour in wine and let it reduce by half.
Layer half the potatoes in the dish, season, then spread the lardon and onion mixture over. Top with remaining potatoes.
Cut reblochon in half horizontally and lay both halves rind-side up over the potatoes.
Bake 25 min until the cheese is bubbling and golden. Rest 5 min before serving.

title: Pasta Carbonara
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
Fry pancetta in a dry pan until crispy, then remove from heat.
Beat eggs with grated parmesan and a generous pinch of black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving a cup of pasta water.
Add hot pasta to the pan with pancetta (off heat). Pour egg mixture over and toss quickly, adding a splash of pasta water to make it creamy.

title: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden and crispy.
Halve the avocado, remove the pit, and scoop into a bowl.
Mash with a fork, squeeze in lemon juice, and season with salt.
Spread avocado on toast.
Top with chili flakes and a poached egg if using.

title: Red Lentil Soup
steps: Dice onion and mince garlic.
Heat olive oil in a pot, soften onion for 5 min, add garlic and spices, cook 1 min.
Add rinsed lentils, tomatoes, and stock. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 20 min until lentils are soft.
Blend half the soup for a creamy texture, then stir back in. Adjust seasoning.

title: Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Slice chicken into thin strips and mince garlic and ginger.
Cut pepper and courgette into thin strips.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat until smoking.
Cook chicken 4–5 min until golden, then set aside.
Stir-fry vegetables 3 min, add garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return chicken, add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss everything together and serve.

title: Tomato Bruschetta
steps: Dice tomatoes and combine with torn basil, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Let sit 10 min.
Toast or grill the bread slices until charred at the edges.
Rub each slice with the cut side of a garlic clove.
Spoon the tomato mixture generously over each slice and serve immediately.

title: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Slice mushrooms and finely chop shallot and garlic.
Sauté mushrooms in butter until golden, set aside.
In the same pan, soften shallot and garlic, then add rice and toast 1 min.
Add wine and stir until absorbed.
Add stock one ladle at a time, stirring constantly, until each addition is absorbed — about 18 min.
Stir in mushrooms and parmesan, season, and rest 2 min before serving.

title: Greek Salad
steps: Chop tomatoes and cucumber into chunks, slice red onion thinly.
Combine in a bowl with olives.
Drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle oregano, and season with salt.
Place feta block on top (or crumble over) and serve.

title: Banana Pancakes
steps: Mash bananas thoroughly in a bowl.
Beat in eggs and cinnamon until smooth.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour small rounds of batter and cook 2 min per side until golden.
Serve with honey, fruit, or yoghurt.
